title: koeleria britannica
intro: Koeleria britannica, commonly known as June grass, is a perennial grass species native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health, thanks to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Koeleria britannica include its use in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as its potential in treating gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
